SEN.note: ARTP only asks whether data localisation obligations should be imposed on satellite operators; no rule or drafting is stated.
Nothing on rural programmes or rural-urban internet use.
Nothing on state budget for digital programmes; Sonatel's FDSUT contributions are an operator's, not a budget line.

facts.fact: The telecoms regulator ARTP opened a national consultation, open until 21 October 2026, to gather views of sector actors on the regime (licence, authorisation or declaration) and obligations for satellite operators.
facts.system: ARTP national consultation on satellite regulatory framework

facts.fact: The document says an authorisation was granted to Starlink in Senegal, which Sonatel challenged in court and which the unions queried in February 2026.
The Supreme Court ordered the provisional suspension of Starlink's authorisation on 7 September 2026, finding a serious doubt over its legality.
